description: This file declares functions and interfaces for oneDNN (Intel Deep Neural Network Library) operations such as matrix multiplication, convolution, deconvolution, and related backward passes, specifically optimized for SYCL and integrated with PyTorch's ATen library.

methods.name: matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication using oneDNN with SYCL event handling.

methods.name: convolution
methods.description: Performs convolution operation with specified parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: convolution_backward_weights
methods.description: Computes gradients of weights during convolution backward pass.

methods.name: convolution_backward_data
methods.description: Computes gradients of input data during convolution backward pass.

methods.name: deconvolution_backward_data
methods.description: Computes gradients of input data during deconvolution backward pass.

methods.name: deconvolution_backward_weights
methods.description: Computes gradients of weights during deconvolution backward pass.

methods.name: woq_matmul_int4
methods.description: Performs weight-quantized matrix multiplication with int4 precision.

methods.name: quantized_matmul
methods.description: Performs quantized matrix multiplication with optional binary and unary post-operations.

methods.name: sdpa_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for scaled dot-product attention.

methods.name: scaled_matmul
methods.description: Performs scaled matrix multiplication with optional bias and scaling choices.
